Chapter 397: Chapter 12: Ordinary Members of Magic Jade Tower (Please Subscribe)_3

On the topic of innate talent, humans can never surpass those special beings in the depths of space.

Of course, when it comes to falling short, we’re talking about entire clans. If we consider individuals, given the population base of human civilization, every so often there emerge some monstrous prodigies who are not the least bit inferior to those special beings.

However,

among the clans of special beings, geniuses and prodigies are also born.

And this dragon-horned, green-skinned man, his seizure target was a genius from one of those special being clans.

His comprehension of various rules was extremely terrifying, with robust vitality, an unmatched physical body, truly formidable.

...

In his quest to comprehend the Supreme Evolution Path, this dragon-horned, green-skinned man had paid a steep price; capturing such a special being genius alive was no easy task.

One and a half years later,

the dragon-horned, green-skinned man looked terrible, with layers of vague shadows shrouding his consciousness.

“Is this a Heart Demon?”

“Damn it, wasn’t it said that only an extremely small number of Evolution Paths would bring forth a Heart Demon?”

The dragon-horned, green-skinned man exhaled gently; he was already an Eighth Layer Evolver with a Mental Will Index exceeding ten thousand points. For him, surviving a Heart Demon Tribulation again was not difficult.

“No, this is the Nine Layers Heart Demon Tribulation…”

A moment later, the dragon-horned, green-skinned man let out a mournful howl.

…

“There are simply too many geniuses in human civilization…”

Lin Yuan sat on the mountaintop, watching batch after batch of human prodigious Evolvers come in.

These Evolvers, perhaps in terms of comprehension, were far inferior to Lin Yuan, but in other areas, such as constitution, bloodline, soul, and so on, they each had their unique strengths.

Ad this was only the Virtual World Lin Yuan was in.

Besides this Virtual World, there were countless others, each allowing for the comprehension of that segment of the body.

“Pity, they all failed.”

“So far, not one of the geniuses attempting to feel that body has found the Supreme Evolution Path?”

Lin Yuan silently pondered.

“Perhaps, the Supreme Beings were wrong? Inside this segment of the body, there’s no such thing as the Supreme Evolution Path?”

“Or maybe, the body that contains the Supreme Evolution Path isn’t this segment, but rather on a body held by other Peak Clans?”

Lin Yuan speculated.

“But what does that have to do with me?”

“I had no expectation of comprehending that Supreme Evolution Path at all.”

“I’m already quite satisfied just by contemplating and analyzing the common Evolution Paths contained within the body.”

Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts and continued to observe the segment of the body under the vault of heaven.

[Your comprehension is against nature, observing the mysterious corpse, you’ve comprehended the three thousand three hundred and thirty-third Evolution Path…]

Time passed unnoticed.

Lin Yuan once again comprehended a new Evolution Path.

Counting from the first Evolution Path he had comprehended to the current one, Lin Yuan had now realized three thousand three hundred and thirty-three Evolution Paths.

“Analysis.”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

However,

before Lin Yuan could conduct an analysis on this new Evolution Path,

Boom.

Within Lin Yuan’s memory, the three thousand three hundred and thirty-second Evolution Path he had previously comprehended, and this three thousand three hundred and thirty-third Evolution Path, unexpectedly triggered some sort of mutation.

In an indistinct manner, the three thousand three hundred and thirty-three Evolution Paths formed a ‘Nine Floors Dark Tower’ mark, merging deep into his soul.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan was startled in his heart.

The next moment,

the murmuring sound exerting Psychic Will Pressure from that segment of the body, which had been causing Lin Yuan a great deal of stress, suddenly became clear.

“Comprehending three thousand three hundred and thirty-three Evolution Paths, forming the Magic Jade Mark, automatically becomes a regular member of the Magic Jade Tower.”
